_provenance.note: Drafted from the source article by scripts/tuf/import_season.mjs, which reads the bracket templates and the episode summaries separately and joins them. Where the two disagree the bout carries no winner and the disagreement is recorded in _conflicts. Finale results are not asserted here; they are verified against our own result rows in seasons.json.

_conflicts.detail: The source's semi-finals for this division do not close as a self-contained round: 1 fighter(s) enter this round without a recorded win in the previous one. That is what a wildcard, second chance or replacement entry looks like, and also what a missing bout looks like; the bracket alone does not say which. The stated bouts are recorded as given and the round is left unverified rather than reordered into something the source does not say.
1 bout(s) appear in the episode summaries but in no bracket: Albert Cheng def. Yong Shun. Left unplaced rather than assigned to a division by guesswork.

format_exceptions.detail: Le meets with Fu Ziyi and tells him that he's on the show as a replacement. He is very excited to be there and Zhang welcomes him.

Le welcomes Dong's replacement Yong Shun to Team Flying Lions. He mentions later that he doesn't know anything about him and he noticed that he is a very quiet person. It is not revealed if he will enter directly to the semi-finals or if he will have to fight before.
Chong decides not to do heavy training along with the other fighters because he still has an injured neck and will fight within a day or two, so he prefers to tread lightly.

Fu is still struggling to cut weight and thinks about quitting. Cung Le advises him not to do it because it would take a toll on his career. Fu decides to keep trying. Later though Le reveals that Fu won't be able to make weight and the UFC wants him to be removed from the show. They will decide whether he will be replaced by an alternate or someone from his team. Fu says goodbye to his teammates
Concerned about an injured hand, Wang Sai prefers to avoid a visit to the hospital as he could find himself removed from his fight due to the injury.
